papers.title: Shared Models, Selective Trading, and Order Flow
papers.summary: In synthetic markets of LLM traders, news presentation shifts which model families submit orders, and this selection can improve or worsen price accuracy.

papers.title: Pragmatic DML with AI-Learned Representations
papers.summary: Shows imperfect AI-learned representations bias causal parameters by a product of two errors, and develops DML inference, aggregation pipelines and sensitivity bounds, applied to estimating demand elasticity.

papers.title: Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting
papers.summary: Places an LLM inside DSGE simulators and trains it with PPO, so its policy actions are judged by their simulated economic consequences rather than by how plausible they sound.

papers.title: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
papers.summary: PPO agent blended with a regime prior improves Sharpe ratio and cuts SPY drawdown to 18% versus 34% for buy-and-hold.

papers.title: Judgement in the Age of Jev: From Evaluation Scarcity to Evaluation Abundance
papers.summary: Formulates a conditional Jevons hypothesis that cheap machine evaluation may increase its use inside organisations, and examines the implications for judgement and authority.

papers.title: Modeling Shipping Emissions: Machine Learning, Engineering, and Policy Counterfactuals
papers.summary: Pure ML models of ship emissions predict well but attenuate speed responses; hybrid structural-ML models preserve them, which matters because attenuation can flip the sign of policy net benefits.

papers.title: Do Your Own Research: Learning to Forecast by Learning to Search
papers.summary: A small RL-trained search agent forecasting Polymarket questions edges frontier models at about 5% of the inference cost.

papers.title: Architecture Without an Architect? Global Governance of Artificial Intelligence in a Divided World
papers.summary: Review essay argues global AI governance design cannot be separated from the distribution of power among states and firms.

papers.title: The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
papers.summary: Open-source framework supports technical testing within EU AI Act regulatory sandboxes, piloted in a live sandbox engagement.
